title: DocpipeIpc
description: JSON-RPC methods for docpipe, including the PDFium page model and B-S3-04 offline OCR.

methods.description: Frozen method catalogue for B-S1-05 triage and B-S1-06 recognition.

frozen_methods.name: docpipe.version
frozen_methods.summary: Sidecar version, batch, classifier_id, recognizer_id, thresholds.

frozen_methods.name: docpipe.parse_pdf
frozen_methods.summary: Parse an in-memory PDF into real pages, text/layout coordinates, OCR routing, explicit failures, and resumable checkpoints.

frozen_methods.name: docpipe.triage_pages
frozen_methods.summary: Classify one or more pages; returns per-page triage_class + confidence.

frozen_methods.name: docpipe.recognize_pages
frozen_methods.summary: Produce word-level text layers with engine confidence and normalized geometry from rendered pages.

frozen_methods.name: docpipe.recognize_document
frozen_methods.summary: Recognize PDF/JPG/PNG content fully offline, routing native and scanned pages and enforcing review gates.

frozen_methods.name: docpipe.render_page
frozen_methods.summary: Return the deterministic processed OCR coordinate surface for human word-overlay inspection.

runtime_notes_from_prd: OCR / vision / HTR pipeline + overnight batch queue.
Spawned on demand; killed when idle.
Vision / HTR model used only by docpipe; never concurrent with primary reasoner on 8 GB.
Overnight batch must be resumable after power loss (AC-6.8).
Every word has a confidence score; thresholds from constants.json (§6.2).
x-caseforge.recognizer_note: Native PDF text uses caseforge.pdfium.native-text.v1. Scanned/mixed pages use pinned caseforge.ocr.tesseract-eng-fast.v1; warned/empty pages are blocked from automatic extraction.
